ns2:course.label: Professional SBC Capstone Project
ns2:course.description: This course serves as a capstone, requiring the student to demonstrate a mastery of knowledge in the primary areas of Strategic Brand Communication. The project is designed to allow the student to demonstrate his/her mastery of strategic brand communication, focused on Creating and Executing a Research Plan; Repositioning Analysis and Strategy; Strategic Brand Communication Strategy & Tactics; Media Strategy & Tactics; Campaign Monitoring and Evaluation. 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: SBC 511. Restricted to MS: SBC students.
